slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Successful projects start long before the technology is installed

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Technology projects rarely become difficult because of technology alone. Delays usually happen when planning is incomplete, business priorities change or unexpected dependencies appear during implementation.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: The strongest projects come from careful planning, realistic timelines and early risk identification, spotting the outdated infrastructure, connectivity constraints and hidden dependencies before they turn into delays.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Project work is scoped, planned and delivered by the same engineers who support you afterwards, so nothing is handed over to a team that has never seen your environment. WhizzIT is Cyber Essentials certified and a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider, so our security fundamentals are independently assessed rather than simply claimed. It is priced per user at a fixed monthly cost rather than bundled into rigid packages, so it scales with your team. Everything runs through the same UK service desk that handles your day-to-day tickets, so there is no separate team to chase.
